steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') })()

steps.name: enter-room-editor
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().enterRoomEditor('livingDining')

steps.name: P3-open-catalog
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setLeftMode('catalog'); s.setCatalogOpen(true) })()

steps.name: P17-probe-skeleton
steps.eval: (() => { const sk=[...document.querySelectorAll('.card-thumb .skeleton')]; const one=sk[0]; const cs=one&&getComputedStyle(one); console.log('PROBE skeleton count', sk.length, 'anim', cs && cs.animationName, 'dur', cs && cs.animationDuration) })()

steps.name: P3-probe-stage
steps.eval: (() => { const sa=document.querySelector('.stage-area'); const cs=sa&&getComputedStyle(sa); console.log('PROBE stage-area transition', cs && cs.transitionProperty, cs && cs.transitionDuration, 'left', cs && cs.left) })()

steps.name: P17-probe-resolved
steps.eval: (() => { const imgs=document.querySelectorAll('.card-thumb img'); const sk=document.querySelectorAll('.card-thumb .skeleton'); console.log('PROBE resolved thumbs imgs', imgs.length, 'remaining skeletons', sk.length) })()

steps.name: P16-open-hq-render
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setHqRenderOpen(true)

steps.name: P16-start-render
steps.eval: (() => { window.__hqLoadingSeen=''; const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const b=btns.find(x=>/Start render|Re-render/.test(x.textContent||'')); if(b) b.click(); let n=0; const tick=()=>{ const lb=document.querySelector('.btn.is-loading'); if(lb){ window.__hqLoadingSeen = lb.className+'|aria-busy='+lb.getAttribute('aria-busy')+'|disabled='+lb.disabled } if(++n<90) requestAnimationFrame(tick) }; requestAnimationFrame(tick) })()

steps.name: P16-probe-loading
steps.eval: console.log('PROBE hq loading class seen:', window.__hqLoadingSeen || '(none captured)')

steps.name: P16-close-hq
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setHqRenderOpen(false)

steps.name: P5-toast-success
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().notify.start({ title: 'Design saved', kind: 'success' })

steps.name: P5-probe-toast
steps.eval: (() => { const ic=document.querySelector('.toast .icn.pop'); const cs=ic&&getComputedStyle(ic); console.log('PROBE toast pop anim', cs && cs.animationName, 'dur', cs && cs.animationDuration) })()

steps.name: P5-seed-items-and-pending
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>x.id==='livingDining')||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+ (r.width||3)/2, cz=r.origin[1]+(r.depth||3)/2; const items=[{ id:'ec-seed-0', defId:'sofa-3seat', position:[cx,cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]; s.setItems(items); s.selectItem('ec-seed-0'); s.setPendingEdit({ kind:'transform', ids:['ec-seed-0'], originals:[{ id:'ec-seed-0', position:[cx-0.2,cz], rotation:0 }] }); console.log('PROBE seeded pending') })()

steps.name: P5-click-confirm-capture-leave
steps.eval: (() => { window.__leaveSeen=''; const b=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm-btn.confirm'); b.click(); let n=0; const tick=()=>{ const el=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm'); if(el){ window.__leaveSeen = el.className } if(++n<20) requestAnimationFrame(tick) }; requestAnimationFrame(tick) })()

steps.name: P5-probe-leaving
steps.eval: console.log('PROBE editconfirm leave class seen:', window.__leaveSeen || '(none)')

steps.name: P5-seed-pending-again
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>x.id==='livingDining')||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+(r.width||3)/2, cz=r.origin[1]+(r.depth||3)/2; s.setItems([{ id:'ec-seed-1', defId:'sofa-3seat', position:[cx,cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]); s.selectItem('ec-seed-1'); s.setPendingEdit({ kind:'transform', ids:['ec-seed-1'], originals:[{ id:'ec-seed-1', position:[cx-0.2,cz], rotation:0 }] }) })()

steps.name: P5-click-cancel-capture-shake
steps.eval: (() => { window.__shakeSeen=''; const b=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm-btn.cancel'); b.click(); let n=0; const tick=()=>{ const el=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm'); if(el){ window.__shakeSeen = el.className } if(++n<20) requestAnimationFrame(tick) }; requestAnimationFrame(tick) })()

steps.name: P5-probe-shake
steps.eval: console.log('PROBE editconfirm reject class seen:', window.__shakeSeen || '(none)')

steps.name: P28-empty-items
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([])

steps.name: P28-to-layers
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setLeftMode('layers')

steps.name: P28-probe-cta
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.empty-mini button, .empty-cta, button')].find(x=>/Open catalog/.test(x.textContent||'')); console.log('PROBE empty CTA present:', !!b, b && b.textContent.trim()) })()

steps.name: P28-click-cta
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/^\s*Open catalog\s*$/.test(x.textContent||'')); if(b) b.click() })()

steps.name: RM-emulate-reduced-motion
steps.eval: (() => { const st=document.createElement('style'); st.id='rm-emulate'; st.textContent='*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:0.01ms !important;animation-delay:0ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important;transition-duration:0.01ms !important;transition-delay:0ms !important;}'; document.head.appendChild(st) })()

steps.name: RM-reopen-catalog
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setCatalogOpen(false); s.setLeftMode('catalog'); s.setCatalogOpen(true) })()

steps.name: RM-toast
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().notify.start({ title: 'Saved (reduced motion)', kind: 'success' })
